description_en: Buĩcā Hiti, believed to be built during the premiership of Juddha Śamśera Rāṇā, is one of three hitis located at the bottom of the Imūdvã hillock in Lalitpur. Thehitiis mostly used by local residents who are members of the Poḍhe caste.Thehitihas one water spout with a stone statue of Bhagīratha underneath and a Varuṇa statue with a canopy of seven serpents above. Ajaḥdhuṃhitiis insatlled in the western wall.It is believed that thehitiwas built during the reign of Prime Minister Juddha Śamśera Rāṇā [r. 1932-1945] (Lalitpur Sub-Metropolitan City2007, 39).Aphalcānext to thehitiwas reconstructed in 1844 CE (NS 964) from the ground up. Thephalcāwas built to serve those coming to collect water, take a shower, or do laundry.A minor renovation of the Buĩcā Hiti took place in 2017 CE (VS 2074) when thehitisandphalcāsin the Ālko quarter were renovated with funding from the World Bank and the Lalitpur Municipality. However, little attention was paid to its authenticity and the use of appropriate material during the renovation process.In the present-day (April 2021), very little water is available, and the site is littered with garbage and overgrown by weeds. Even though community members (mostly women) fill plastic bottles with the available water, no attention seems to be paid to maintain even basic level of cleanliness at thehiti. Moreover, due to rapid urbanization resulting in ground water depletion, the Hiti almost dries up during the dry seasons, but flows during the monsoon. The local community cleans the Hiti on the day of the Sithinakhaḥ, the sixth day of the bright fortnight of Jyeṣṭha.
description_ne: ललितपुरको आल्को हिति (LAL0990) पछाडि पोडेहरूको बसोबास रहेको इमूद्वँ भनिने थुम्को छ । उक्त थुम्कोसँगै तीनवटा हिति (हिटी) निर्माण गरिएका छन् । ती तीनवटा हितिमध्ये बुइँचा हिति पनि एक हो । यो हितिको पानी विशेष गरी पोडेहरूले प्रयोग गर्छन् । यस हितिमा एउटा मात्र टुटी बनाइएको छ । टुटीमुनि भगीरथको मूर्ति राखिएको छ । टुटीमाथि सातवटा नागले ओढाइएका वरुणको मूर्ति राखिएको छ । हितिको पश्चिमपट्टि भित्तामा ज:रुँहिति राखिएको छ ।यो हितिको निर्माणबारे प्रष्ट पार्ने कुनै ऐतिहासिक स्रोत फेलापरेको छैन । यो हितिलाई राणा प्रधानमन्त्री जुद्धशमशेर (शासनकाल सन् १९३२-१९४५) को पालामा निर्माण गरिएको भनी लेखिएको छ (Lalitpur Sub-Metropolitan City2007, 36) । हितिसँगै रहेको फल्चा भत्केर पाताल भएपछि नेसं ९६४ (सन् १८४४) मा पुनर्निर्माण गरिएको थियो ।हिति निर्माण गरिएपछि हितिमा नुहाउने र पानी थाप्नेहरूको सुविधाको लागि फल्चा निर्माण गरिेने हो । नेसं ९६४ (सन् १८४४) मा फल्चाको पुनर्निर्माण गरिएकोले त्यसभन्दा धेरै अघि नै फल्चाको निर्माण गरिएको हुनुपर्छ । यसबाट जुद्धशमशेरको शासनकालभन्दा अघि नै हितिको निर्माण गरिएको थियो भन्ने कुरा बुझिन्छ ।विसं २०७४ (सन् २०१७) मा प्व:त्वा: (आल्को) मा रहेका हिति र फल्चाहरूको पुनर्निर्माण-मर्मत गर्ने परियोजना अन्तर्गत यस हितिको पनि सामान्य मर्मत गरिएको थियो । विश्व बैंककोआर्थिक सहयोगमा ललितपुर उप-महानगरपालिकाले हितिको सामान्य मर्मत गरेको थियो । मर्मत गरिएपनि हितिको अवस्थामा कुनै सुधार भएको देखिँदैन । बढ्दो शहरीकरणले गर्दा जमीनमुनि पानीको सतह घट्दै गएकाले सुख्खा याममा हिति सुक्ने गर्छ ।वर्षको एकपल्ट ज्येष्ठ शुक्ल ६ (सिथिनख:) को दिनमा टोलवासीहरू मिलेर हिति सफा गर्छन् ।

historical_events.event_description: The information board installed by PURPP/LMC records the initial construction of thehitiand itsguthi. It reads: “Thishitiwas built in Nepal Sambat 870. The Makara headed Hiti faces north (sic). There is aguthiassociate with thehiti. The source of water of thishitiis Emudon, a hillock on the backside of thehiti.”There is no evidence to verify the information recorded on this board.

The ID plaque was placed by the Heritage Conservation Centre, Lalitpur Metropolitan City, and the Centre for Integrated Urban Development (CUID) as part of an project inventorising heritage sites inLalitpur.
Thehitiwas repaired by the Lalitpur Metropolitan City with funding from the World Bank.
